strategies.name: Nasdaq Leveraged Trend
strategies.tagline: Trend-followed Nasdaq leverage with a volatility budget.
strategies.description: Own a volatility-sized mix of QQQ and TQQQ while the Nasdaq-100 is above its 165-day average. When the trend breaks, move to T-bills.
strategies.dataNote: 5- and 10-year tests use real TQQQ. The 20- and 26-year tests use a synthetic 3x QQQ series for the whole window, including after 2010, to keep one consistent price path.

strategies.name: S&P 500 2x Trend
strategies.tagline: The original leverage rotation, applied to the S&P 500.
strategies.description: Hold the 2x S&P 500 fund (SSO) while SPY is above its 200-day average; hold short-term Treasuries (SHY) below it. No volatility target.
strategies.dataNote: All windows use real SSO prices. SSO started in June 2006, so the 20-year window is the full listed history.

strategies.name: Nasdaq 3x Simple Trend
strategies.tagline: The same Nasdaq rule without the volatility target.
strategies.description: Hold TQQQ at full size while QQQ is above its 200-day average; hold BIL below it. An ablation that shows what the volatility target adds.
strategies.dataNote: 5- and 10-year tests use real TQQQ. The 20- and 26-year tests use a synthetic 3x QQQ series for the whole window.
